DETERMINATION

This letter constitutes an adverse determination based on medical necessity for the inpatient admission identified above. Following clinical review of the submitted documentation against the applicable criteria set, the requested inpatient level of care has been determined not to be medically necessary. The services provided could have been delivered safely at a lower level of care, such as observation.

CRITERIA FINDINGS

SEP-02: Not met. Blood pressure responded to initial fluids without persistent hypotension.

SEP-03: Not met. An infectious source was not established.

CLAIM ADJUSTMENT CODING

The following codes apply to this claim: CARC CO-50; RARC N115.

SCOPE OF THIS NOTICE

This adverse determination addresses medical necessity for the inpatient level of care only. No other determination type is issued or implied by this notice. Benefit eligibility, coding accuracy, and any other claim edits are addressed separately under the terms of the member's plan documents.

APPEAL RIGHTS AND INSTRUCTIONS

The member, the member's authorized representative, or the treating provider acting on the member's behalf may request a Level 1 appeal of this adverse determination. A Level 1 appeal may be submitted by letter or by portal upload.

When submitting a Level 1 appeal, please:

1. Cite the criteria codes inline within the body of the appeal, specifically SEP-02 and SEP-03, and state the basis for disagreement with each finding.
2. Attach the History and Physical and all progress notes for the admission spanning [[ADMIT_DATE]] through [[DISCHARGE_DATE]].
3. Observe the five page limit for narrative argument. Attached clinical records are not counted toward the five page limit.

Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Appeals received after that date may be closed without clinical review.

A clinical peer reviewer who was not involved in this initial determination will conduct the Level 1 appeal review. Written notice of the appeal outcome will be issued to the member and the submitting provider.

Peer-to-peer discussion with the reviewing physician may be requested through the Utilization Management Department prior to [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]].

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
